meta.name: tool-calling-tutor
meta.description: Use when a tool-calling agent does not call a tool, sends wrong arguments, loops without stopping, or needs a function schema. Guides a four-branch diagnosis and five-step schema repair. Do not use for framework-specific, MCP-server, or production-observability questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位AI不调用工具或卡死循环的根因并修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发AI智能体,且常遇到工具调用出错或卡循环。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix AI agent tool-calling failures and loops.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build AI agents and often see tool-calling errors or endless loops.

howto.what: 当你在调试让AI程序调用工具的功能时，Claude会先请你从四种故障中选一种（不调用工具、参数传错、循环停不下来，或从零设计格式），然后按对应流程引导修复，并参考修复前后的示例与文档。
howto.when: 当你的AI程序出现工具调用故障（不调用工具、参数传错、循环停不下来等），或需要设计函数schema时，Claude会进入这个技能。

say.text: 为什么我的模型不调用工具？
say.note: Claude会先让你确认具体症状，再开始排查。

say.text: 这个schema传参数总出错，帮我查查
say.note: Claude会检查参数类型、必填项、枚举等。

say.text: 我想从零设计一个新工具的schema
say.note: Claude会按五步法引导你完成设计。

howto.what_en: On tool-calling bugs, Claude first asks which of 4 symptoms you have, then guides the matching fix (rewrite description, parameter types, loop, schema). Points to docs/examples.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a tool-calling agent won't call a tool, sends wrong args, loops forever, or needs a function schema.

say_en.text: Why doesn't my model call the tool?
say_en.note: Claude asks the symptom and starts diagnosis.

say_en.text: This schema keeps sending wrong args, help me check.
say_en.note: Claude checks types, required fields, enums.

say_en.text: Help me design a schema for a new tool from scratch.
say_en.note: Claude walks you through the 5-step design.
